t: Value Added Monthly Index (VAMI) | Fundpeak
s: February 26, 2021 - This index reflects the growth of a hypothetical $1,000 in a given investment over time. The index is equal to $1,000 at inception. Subsequent month-end values are calculated by multiplying the previous month’s VAMI index by 1 plus the current month rate of return.

t: VAMI financial definition of VAMI
s: A method of tracking the return on an investment over a given period of time in relation to a theoretical $1,000 investment. For example, suppose the yearly return on an investment is 10%; the VAMI would then be 1100.
